soc2_2017_tsc.CC7.2: Monitoring system components for anomalous activity — complete, tamper-evident record of agent tool calls.
soc2_2017_tsc.CC7.3: Evaluation of security events — verifiable reconstruction of what an agent did and when.
soc2_2017_tsc.CC4.1: Ongoing evaluations of internal control — verification is independently re-runnable by any party.
soc2_2017_tsc.PI1.4_PI1.5: Conditional (Processing Integrity in scope): complete, accurate retention of outputs/records with integrity proof.

eu_ai_act.Art. 12(1): Automatic recording of events (logs) over the system lifetime — directly supported, with tamper-evidence exceeding the bar.
eu_ai_act.Art. 12(2)(a): Recording the period of each use — per-call RFC 3339 timestamps (local-clock claims) plus Rekor integratedTime (trusted).
eu_ai_act.Art. 12(2)(b-d): Conditional — reference-database checks, input data, and human-verifier identity are populated only if the SDK user records those fields via record().
eu_ai_act.Art. 19 / Art. 26(6): Provider/deployer log retention — retention with independently verifiable integrity proof.

hipaa_security_rule.45 CFR 164.312(b): Audit controls — record and examine activity in systems containing ePHI.
hipaa_security_rule.45 CFR 164.312(c)(1): Integrity — applied to the audit trail itself (tamper-evident logs). No "HIPAA certification" exists; none is claimed.
